assertions.source: Scaffold identifies the actual open derivation question.

description: Item B of PR #1654: scaffolds the Bring-zero-mode derivation of the bare per-block (α_em/π) at the sign-block of H_3. Identifies the open question is NOT 'derive α_em/π from Bring' (it's the standard QED bubble) but 'derive why EM couples to sign block'.

data.verdict: The 'Bring zero-mode derivation of bare per-block (α_em/π)' open item is structurally CIRCULAR as currently posed: the (α_em/π) IS the standard QED 1-loop coupling, not a Bring-specific derivation. The non-trivial derivation is WHY EM couples to the sign Wedderburn block of H_3 specifically. That requires: (a) substrate-level implementation of QCD color-singlet (Fermi-statistics → sign rep), and (b) categorical Wedderburn-projection of the EM coupling. Neither exists yet at the categorical level — this is the actual multi-session open work behind ProtonMassEMSignBlock.
